UpdateLog.description:
<title>New Features</title><font>Tiny</font> - Vehicle pathfinding has been overhauled. Worst-case paths can calculate around 100x faster. New diagonal hitboxes used for pathfinding may produce slightly different paths. - Vehicles now support acceleration through the AccelerationRate stat. Vehicle modders do not need to add the Vanilla Vehicles Expanded comp controller or change existing VehicleDefs. - Pawns carrying a downed pawn can now right-click a vehicle to load them directly. The existing “Load Into Vehicle” gizmo remains available. - Map-wide item searches now include vehicle cargo. - A new raider event deploys paratroopers by parachute.
<title>Additional Changes</title><font>Tiny</font> - Vehicles parked with pawns now disembark them after five in-game hours. The idle warning also includes pawns in vehicle cargo. - Rapid stops now use hand brakes, with tire screech and wear to wheel components. (exact same mechanic as Vanilla Vehicles Expanded, with reduced sound effect time) - Vehicles with no crew requirement for movement can form caravans without a colonist. (aka autonomous vehicles) - Passengers' CaravanBonusSpeedFactor now contributes to vehicle caravan travel speed. - The Form Caravan dialog warns when a vehicle cannot reach the map edge and prevents selecting it for the caravan.
<title>Bug Fixes</title><font>Tiny</font> - Improved how vehicles appear in the UI so they no longer clip outside their frame. Turrets and overlays no longer shift incorrectly at UI scales above 1. - Fixed vehicle hitboxes, region edges, blocked paths, corner cases, and collision checks affecting pathfinding and reachability. - Fixed caravan splitting and merging, pawns' needs in caravans, and the starting tile for boats. - Fixed vehicles disappearing when a regular caravan was converted into a vehicle caravan - Fixed mental states and breaks being applied to vehicles. - Fixed psycasts and abilities being unable to target vehicles. - Fixed launch range and fuel checks for aerial vehicles. - Fixed being unable to reform a caravan at a site when every colonist was in a vehicle. - Fixed passengers losing ideology roles after leaving a vehicle. - Fixed banished pawns remaining inside vehicles. - Fixed turrets retaining targets after running out of ammo and failing to reload when switching ammo types. - Fixed vehicles failing to target or run over hostile manhunter animals. - Fixed vehicle caravan speed calculations, their world-map display, and repairs using the crew's construction speed correctly.
<title>Final Notes</title><font>Tiny</font> There have been many changes since the 1.6 release, so some vehicle mods may need to be updated with Vehicle-Framework 1.7 in order to work.
Please report any issues you find on either <link>https://discord.gg/zXDyfWQ</link>(discord) or <link>https://github.com/SmashPhil/Vehicle-Framework/issues</link>(github).
